summary: Future FinTech Group Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose Pre-Paid Purchase #3 under an existing Pre-Paid Securities Purchase Agreement with Avondale Capital, LLC. The company issued a Pre-Paid Instrument with a $2,160,000 principal amount in exchange for $2,000,000 cash proceeds, reflecting an 8% original issue discount. This is the third tranche of a previously disclosed up-to-$10 million funding facility approved by shareholders. The terms are substantially consistent with prior purchases. The filing describes routine financing mechanics (OID, share registration) without a special-situation event such as acquisition, activist campaign, or restructuring. What to watch: continued drawdown under the facility.
